quotes.text: the HAPI FHIR 14 server is reset and then seeded with task-specific prerequisite resources

parsed.rationale: The server state is reset and seeded before each run and the soft LLM validator is used only during curation. The models are named by family only (GPT-4.1, GPT-4.1-mini, o4-mini) and no HAPI FHIR version, snapshot or commit is stated, so software is not shown as pinned.
